description: Used to display progress (0-100 scale) or a loading state.

props.indeterminate: Constantly animates, use when loading progress is unknown. If set to the string `'disable-shrink'` it will use a simpler animation that does not run on the main thread.
props.reveal: Animates the progress circle from 0 to its model value when the component mounts.
props.rounded: Rounds the ends of the progress arc for a softer appearance. When enabled, the progress stroke will have rounded caps instead of square ends.
props.modelValue: The percentage value for current progress.
props.rotate: Rotates the circle start point in degrees.
props.shape: Sets the shape of the filled portion. **wavy** draws it as an animated wave and applies the **split** gap.
props.size: Sets the diameter of the circle in pixels.
props.transition: Controls the animation to a new value. Pass `{ duration }` in milliseconds or as a CSS duration (e.g. `0.4s`), or `false` to remove it. Does not affect the `indeterminate` and `reveal` animations.
props.variant: Applies a distinct style to the component. **split** visually divides the circle at the current value, separating the filled and unfilled portions with a gap.
props.width: Sets the stroke of the circle in pixels.
